_about: Known failing / flaky tests per CI platform (runner.os). Owned by L1. Entries may only be REMOVED when a test is fixed, never added to hide a regression. 'out_of_scope' lists node-id patterns of components that cannot run on that platform by design; those tests still run and are reported, and stay fully gated on the platforms where the component runs. Every entry and scope must be traceable in docs/v1/INTEGRATION_LOG.md. 'skipped_platform' lists test modules that skip themselves as a whole on that platform (module-level importorskip); only that skip is tolerated, any failure in them still fails the gate. A node may appear in only one category.

Windows.flaky_note: test_03b_atomic_expired_lease_reclaim_single_winner: pre-existing (unchanged since e95aa787), failed once on windows-latest in run 36810693808 attempt 1 on a docs-only commit and passed on re-run (attempt 2) and in ~10 other Windows runs. Indicates a real intermittent single-winner race in the expired-lease reclaim on Windows; tracked as a finding for the owner, still run and reported every time.

skipped_platform.reason: module calls pytest.importorskip("fcntl") (POSIX-only) and skips itself as a whole on Windows
skipped_platform.rule: Only the module-level skip is tolerated. Any node of these modules that runs and fails fails the gate; out_of_scope patterns do not apply inside these modules.
